subject.title: fix(fal): image generation hangs on slow generated-image downloads

question: Should fal generated-image downloads use the same hard 30s HTTP timeout as fal generated-video downloads?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and correct, but the exact hard timeout changes upgrade behavior for unusually slow but otherwise valid generated-image downloads.

options.title: Accept the 30s bound
options.body: Land the PR with the sibling video timeout, accepting that exceptionally slow generated-image downloads now fail instead of hanging.

options.title: Thread an operation budget
options.body: Ask for a patch that derives the download bound from the existing image generation request timeout if long legitimate downloads must remain possible.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30s bound
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the sibling video timeout, accepting that exceptionally slow generated-image downloads now fail instead of hanging.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared-transport work on fal image generation makes this the best available owner for the timeout-boundary choice.
